authority_boundary.notes: Templates preserve user-reviewed construction guidance from LXY P1-P5. Reuse supports draft transcription only and never promotes a crop reading to final score facts.

review_guidance_source.used_for: guardrail wording and gold/forbidden prioritization; file content is not copied into repo as authority

templates.slot_semantics: right-hand 勾 plus embedded/lower string 一
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui may inherit when explicitly marked
templates.needs_human_review_when: context source or boundary uncertain
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: right-hand 勾 plus embedded/lower string 二
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui may inherit when explicitly marked
templates.needs_human_review_when: component match is medium_low or inherited context unclear
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: right-hand 勾 plus embedded/lower string 三
templates.context_inheritance_policy: often inherits prior left hand/hui; must mark context_inherited
templates.needs_human_review_when: inheritance chain crosses groups or phrase boundary
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: 托 as right-hand action; 七 as string when embedded/lower in action construction
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui supplied by visible 大指六二 or reviewed context
templates.needs_human_review_when: hui cluster or punctuation boundary unclear
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: COMP-018 lower support shape is 挑; 六 is string in action construction
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui from visible 名指七 or context
templates.needs_human_review_when: hui 七九 uses human-reviewed target without separate 九 component
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: 挑 action plus string 四
templates.context_inheritance_policy: inherits left hand/hui when marked
templates.needs_human_review_when: candidate could be misread as bare 四
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: 历 as cross-string sequential action; 五四 are visible string targets
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui may inherit; mark context_inherited
templates.needs_human_review_when: sounding-unit split or direction needs confirmation
review_guardrails: 历 is 连挑; when user confirms 历五四, read 五到四, not layout-derived order.
Do not use jianpu or spacing to infer the span.

templates.slot_semantics: 散音起始 sets open-string state; 挑五 supplies visible sounding action/string
templates.sound_policy: candidate_sounding_unit only because right-hand action is visible
templates.context_inheritance_policy: no left-hand/hui inheritance required for open-string state unless reviewed
templates.needs_human_review_when: connected 散音 marker could be confused with separate components
review_guardrails: COMP-027 散音起始 is the upper/open-string state layer; lower 挑五 supplies the right-hand/string construction.
Do not misread the connected grass-head-like COMP-027 as 大指 plus hui number.
散音起始 alone is non-sounding unless paired with visible right-hand/string evidence or human confirmation.

templates.slot_semantics: 大指 left-hand; 六二 in hui slot; 轮 right-hand compound; 七 string
templates.sound_policy: compound action candidate; expansion remains parser-stage/review work
templates.context_inheritance_policy: no silent inheritance; host context must be explicit
templates.needs_human_review_when: 轮 subaction expansion or string target scope is needed
review_guardrails: Preserve v0.4 correction: COMP-029 is 轮 and COMP-028 is 撞.
Do not fall back to raw_001=轮 or raw_003=撞 mappings.

templates.slot_semantics: 轮 right-hand compound plus visible string 七
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui may be supplied by host construction
templates.needs_human_review_when: expansion into 摘-剔-挑 is requested
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: left-hand position / virtual attack candidate
templates.sound_policy: non-sounding by default unless human review says otherwise
templates.context_inheritance_policy: host/attachment to prior position must be reviewed
templates.needs_human_review_when: host hui or independent-event status is needed
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: 急 timing marker plus 进复 position transition
templates.context_inheritance_policy: attachment and target remain reviewable
templates.needs_human_review_when: boundary merges neighboring visual pieces
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: 进复 with nearby 五六 as hui-position candidate
templates.context_inheritance_policy: host event / attachment scope review required
templates.needs_human_review_when: attachment or target scope unclear
review_guardrails: 进五六复 is a left-hand position/hui transition candidate; 五六 is not a string span here.
Do not infer this from jianpu or spacing.

templates.slot_semantics: 上 transition with 六二 as hui-position candidate
templates.context_inheritance_policy: host/continuation scope review required
templates.needs_human_review_when: six-two target or correction from six-three is relevant
review_guardrails: 上六二 is a left-hand position/hui transition candidate; nearby 六二 is read as hui target by construction.
Do not read it as strings 六 and 二.

templates.slot_semantics: context inheritance marker
templates.context_inheritance_policy: must mark context_inherited and source of inherited state
templates.needs_human_review_when: phrase opening or cross-phrase inheritance is involved
review_guardrails: 就 is a context-inheritance marker and is normally rendered as 承前 behavior in continuous reading.
Do not confuse 就 with 少息.

templates.slot_semantics: enter harmonic state boundary
templates.context_inheritance_policy: scope must be reviewed
templates.needs_human_review_when: state scope across following groups matters
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: exit harmonic state boundary
templates.context_inheritance_policy: scope must be reviewed
templates.needs_human_review_when: boundary placement affects following sound type
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: timing / breath marker
templates.context_inheritance_policy: does not reset inherited left-hand/hui unless reviewed
templates.needs_human_review_when: duration/scope is needed
review_guardrails: 少息 is a timing marker, not 就.
Do not generate a sounding_unit for 少息.

templates.slot_semantics: punctuation / phrase end
templates.context_inheritance_policy: phrase boundary inheritance must be explicit if used later
templates.needs_human_review_when: phrase boundary affects next candidate
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: right-hand compound action
templates.sound_policy: compound sequence candidate; string span unresolved unless visible/reviewed
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui may inherit; must be marked
templates.needs_human_review_when: string span or subaction sequence is needed
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: 大指 + 注下 pre-attack to 七徽 with reviewed 抹七 action
templates.sound_policy: candidate_sounding_unit only as phrase draft; 抹 action is template evidence from prior review
templates.context_inheritance_policy: host/advance motion scope needs review
templates.needs_human_review_when: visible action is not clearly 抹
review_guardrails: Read visible 抹 as the right-hand action; do not substitute 挑 unless COMP-018 is visible.
注下 remains an approach/lead-in candidate and stays reviewable.

templates.slot_semantics: 大指 + 注下 pre-attack to 七徽 with visible 挑七 action
templates.context_inheritance_policy: host/advance motion scope needs review
templates.needs_human_review_when: neighboring 抹 template might be incorrectly copied
review_guardrails: Blank upper slots may inherit the current left-hand/hui context; do not silently drop the inherited left-hand/hui fields.
Do not copy 抹 from a neighboring template when the visible right-hand action is COMP-018 挑.
注下 indicates a downward approach/lead-in, not direct static pressing only.

templates.slot_semantics: 名指 with 七六 hui candidate; 掐起 special technique with 七 string candidate
templates.sound_policy: special technique sounding policy requires human review
templates.context_inheritance_policy: theory-assisted or human-corrected hui must be marked
templates.needs_human_review_when: sounding policy or hui target source is required
review_guardrails: 掐起七弦 remains a special-technique reading candidate and needs review for sounding policy.
Do not detach 掐起 from its left-hand/hui context.

templates.slot_semantics: 名指 with reviewed 七九 hui target; 挑六 right-hand/string construction
templates.sound_policy: candidate_sounding_unit; 九 lacks separate component sample and remains human-reviewed evidence
templates.context_inheritance_policy: do not infer 九 from layout
templates.needs_human_review_when: hui target needs crop-only proof
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: left-hand ornament attached to prior/host position
templates.context_inheritance_policy: must mark inherited left-hand/hui source
templates.needs_human_review_when: attachment target is ambiguous
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: special technique attached to previous/host position
templates.context_inheritance_policy: prior pressed position may inherit only when explicit
templates.needs_human_review_when: standalone vs attached construction is unclear
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: 大指 + 绰上 approach to 七徽; 勾 with 六 as string
templates.sound_policy: candidate sounding unit only after review
templates.context_inheritance_policy: following blank-upper 注下 constructions may inherit 大指七徽 explicitly
templates.needs_human_review_when: source is user correction or visible construction needs review
review_guardrails: 绰 and 注 are paired approach concepts; read 绰 + 七徽 as 绰上七徽 when construction supports it.
Do not require a separate free-standing 上 component before allowing 绰上.
勾 + 六 must be read as 勾六弦 when the number is embedded/lower/near the right-hand action.

templates.reading_pattern: 大指注下七徽，抹挑七弦
templates.slot_semantics: 大指 + 注下 to 七徽; 抹挑 with 七 as string
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui may inherit only when upper slot blank and source is explicit
templates.needs_human_review_when: compound action expansion or string target is requested
review_guardrails: COMP-031 抹挑 is a compound right-hand action and must not be confused with COMP-036 掩.
Expansion of 抹挑 remains report-only and needs human review.

templates.slot_semantics: 名指 七六 hui target with 掐起 special technique
templates.sound_policy: special technique sounding policy requires human review
templates.context_inheritance_policy: may serve as context source for following 挑四
templates.needs_human_review_when: held finger, string, or sounding policy is needed
review_guardrails: 掐起 binds to a held left-hand position, often 名指 or 跪指, but the target hui must not be hardcoded generically as 七六徽.
If 三分损益法 or tuning logic is used to infer hui, record it as human/theory-assisted review evidence, not crop-only evidence.
Do not treat 掐起 as an independent sounding unit by default.

templates.reading_pattern: 挑四弦（空上部时可承前）
templates.slot_semantics: 挑 action with 四 as string, inheriting prior left-hand/hui
templates.sound_policy: candidate sounding unit with inherited context
templates.context_inheritance_policy: must mark context_inherited=true and source glyph
templates.needs_human_review_when: context source or boundary uncertain
review_guardrails: COMP-018 挑 must not be dropped or read as a bare string number.
Do not hardcode the inherited left-hand/hui value; resolve it from the nearest explicit prior context and mark context_inherited=true.

templates.reading_pattern: 名指注下七九徽，勾三弦
templates.slot_semantics: 名指 + 注下 to 七九 hui target; 勾三 right-hand/string construction
templates.sound_policy: candidate sounding unit only after review
templates.context_inheritance_policy: do not infer 九 from layout; mark user-corrected evidence
templates.needs_human_review_when: 七九 target or component evidence needs crop-only review
review_guardrails: 七九 is a hui-position candidate in the upper/right-upper context, not a string pair.
勾 + 三 must be read as 勾三弦 when construction supports it.

templates.slot_semantics: 大指 七徽 plus 掩 action with 三 as string
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui visible or user-corrected
templates.needs_human_review_when: attachment or sounding policy required
review_guardrails: COMP-036 掩 plus 三 is read as 掩三弦 when construction supports it.
Do not confuse 掩 with COMP-031 抹挑.

templates.slot_semantics: 剔 right-hand action with 四 as string
templates.context_inheritance_policy: left hand/hui may inherit or be absent for open-string context when reviewed
templates.needs_human_review_when: context or sound state is uncertain
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: 剔四 followed by layered 散音-三弦-如一声 construction
templates.sound_policy: two adjacent candidate constructions; final expansion reviewable
templates.context_inheritance_policy: do not merge punctuation into sounding unit
templates.needs_human_review_when: 剔四 and 散三如一 boundary or expansion is requested
review_guardrails: COMP-037 剔 plus 四 must be read as 剔四弦 when construction supports it.
Do not merge final 句号 into a sounding unit.
Keep the 剔四 and 散三如一 boundary reviewable.

templates.slot_semantics: top 散音 marker, middle 三 string, lower 如一声 parts
templates.sound_policy: candidate sounding only because string/action marker is explicit by user correction
templates.context_inheritance_policy: open-string state does not create separate sounding unit by itself
templates.needs_human_review_when: layer decomposition or two-string expansion is requested
review_guardrails: Read from top to bottom as 散音 layer, 三弦 layer, 如一声 layer.
Do not directly expand 如一声 into final Dapu IR at this stage.

templates.slot_semantics: left-hand 双吟 ornament
templates.context_inheritance_policy: attach to prior/host position with context_inherited when needed
templates.needs_human_review_when: attachment target unclear
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: left-hand 落指猱 motion
templates.sound_policy: non-independent/attached by default unless user confirms sounding
templates.context_inheritance_policy: attach to host/inherited position
templates.needs_human_review_when: host position or sounding policy unclear
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.slot_semantics: two-string/as-one marker
templates.context_inheritance_policy: context/host string source must be explicit
templates.needs_human_review_when: two-string expansion requested
review_guardrails: Template reuse remains report-only and NEEDS_HUMAN_REVIEW.

templates.reading_pattern: 勾四弦（空上部时可承前）
templates.slot_semantics: 勾 right-hand action plus embedded/lower/nearby 四 as string number
templates.sound_policy: candidate sounding unit with inherited left-hand/hui context
templates.context_inheritance_policy: must mark context_inherited=true and source of inherited left-hand/hui
templates.needs_human_review_when: component boundary or inherited context is unclear
review_guardrails: Do not output 裸勾 or 勾？ when 四 is visibly embedded/lower/nearby and construction supports right-hand string reading.
Do not make 承前 inherent to all 勾四 cases; only mark context_inherited when upper left-hand/hui slots are blank and a prior context exists.
String 四 must come from visible construction evidence, not jianpu, spacing, old OCR, or old CSV rows.

templates.slot_semantics: 上 left-hand position-taking component with nearby 六四 as hui target by construction
templates.context_inheritance_policy: does not by itself reset inherited right-hand/string context
templates.needs_human_review_when: hui target, attachment scope, or host note is unclear
review_guardrails: 上六四 is a hui-position transition candidate, not strings 六 and 四.
Do not output 上六？ when 四 is visible.

templates.slot_semantics: 下 position-taking context with nearby 七 as target hui/position cue when construction supports it
templates.context_inheritance_policy: must attach to neighboring/next note only with review evidence
templates.needs_human_review_when: 下 marker is not visually isolated enough or attachment to next note is unclear
review_guardrails: Do not treat 下七 as an independent plucked note by default.
Attachment to following 名指七六徽，掐起 remains reviewable.

templates.slot_semantics: upper-left 大指 plus right-upper 六二 hui; lower-left 托 with embedded/inner 七 as string number; punctuation may follow separately
templates.sound_policy: candidate sounding unit; later parser promotion requires human-reviewed reading
templates.context_inheritance_policy: does not inherit left-hand/hui because both are explicit in the construction
templates.needs_human_review_when: right-upper 六二 or embedded 七 boundary is unclear
review_guardrails: 数字六二 in right-upper slot is hui position, not strings.
Embedded 七 inside/near 托 is string number.
Do not merge final 句号 into sounding unit.
